interpretation_limits: Unsuccessful live access acquired no newer observations.
A monthly publication does not automatically establish an independent monthly measurement or an annual fact.
Forty-four conditional target comparisons do not establish official annual attainment.
National source scope is not a comparable regional average in these seven profiles.
One median fill exists only in the retained model matrix; original source series remain unfilled.
Regional clusters are sensitive to feature choice, initial state and period; no ordinal regional ranking is validated.
Algorithmic outlier frequency is not a probability of regional risk.
Plans and budget proposals do not establish cash execution or full costs of individual results.
Document membership and lexical proximity do not identify causal effects.
Author baseline and stemming are separate from four additional platform sensitivity specifications.
